item.name: DJI Osmo Pocket 4P - Pocket Camera | 4K/240fps Slow Motion | New 1" CMOS | Cinematic Colours | 60mm Med-Tele Lens
item.title: DJI Osmo Pocket 4P - Pocket Camera | 4K/240fps Slow Motion | New 1" CMOS | Cinematic Colours | 60mm Med-Tele Lens
item.description:
* Achieved by adjusting skin tone using the in-camera Beautify feature.

1. 12× digital zoom is not supported in Photo, Low-Light, Slow Motion, or Timelapse modes.

2. In D-Log 2 color profile, the maximum dynamic range reaches up to 17 stops.

3. 10-bit D-Log 2 only supports 1× zoom.

4. Only the wide-angle lens supports slow-motion video recording at up to 4K/240fps; the med-tele lens supports slow-motion video recording at up to 4K/200fps. 4K resolution is not supported in vertical shooting mode.

5. The effective range of Gesture Control varies depending on the zoom ratio: approx. 3 meters at 1× to 2× zoom, 4-7 meters at 2× to 3× zoom, and 8-15 meters at 3× to 12× zoom. To control ActiveTrack or recording, use the specific gestures (Palm or V-Sign) and avoid covering your head with your hand. The effective distance may change with future firmware updates.

6. ActiveTrack is not supported in Panorama, Timelapse, Motionlapse, SpinShot modes, or when the gimbal is in FPV mode and the device is held horizontally. For optimal tracking performance, use in well-lit environments. ActiveTrack updates are available via the DJI Mimo app. Please contact DJI Support for details.

7. Zooming is not supported while Multi-Person Tracking is active. To adjust the framing, it is recommended to set your desired zoom level in normal Video mode before enabling the feature. Tracking is limited to 8 people.

8. Film Tone and in-camera Beautify are only available in Video mode and cannot be used simultaneously. When Film Tone is enabled, the in-camera Beautify settings are unavailable. If the in-camera Beautify is already enabled, switching to Film Tone mode will disable the beautify effect.

9. Live Photo only supports 16:9 and 9:16 aspect ratios. The maximum resolution is 4K at 16:9, and 3K at 9:16.

10. Data was tested in a controlled laboratory environment. When using the provided USB-C to USB-C PD Cable (USB 3.1) or another USB 3.1-compliant cable, you can export data from built-in storage at a maximum transfer rate of 800 MB/s.

11. Tested in a laboratory environment with the DJI 65W Portable Charger (sold separately).

12. Tested at room temperature of 25° C (77° F) and 1080p/24fps (16:9), with Wi-Fi off and screen off. This data is for reference only.

13. In both Normal and D-Log color profiles, the maximum dynamic range reaches 14 stops. In Slow Motion mode, the actual dynamic range may be lower than 14 stops.

14. Only supported in Slow Motion mode.

15. The D-Log color profile is only supported in normal Video mode.

16. 2× lossless zoom is not supported in Low-Light, Slow Motion, or Timelapse modes.

17. The App Glamour Effects feature is available only in Video and Low-Light modes, not available in Photo or other modes.
